this_title: The Water Will Carry Us Home
introduction: Middle passage. Slave ship. Orishas. Mermaids. Through living ritual and stop motion animation, The Water Will Carry Us Home tells the story of stolen Africans who are thrown off a slave ship whilst sailing through the Middle Passage. Upon falling into the sea, the unimaginable happens when mermaids, who dwell in these waters, save their spirits.
